source_snapshot.title: Zayed International Airport launches daily Berlin flights with Condor
source_snapshot.text: ABU DHABI, 16th October, 2026 (WAM) -- Zayed International Airport (AUH) announced on Friday the launch of Condor’s new daily, year-round service between Berlin and Abu Dhabi. The new route, operated by an Airbus A320neo, marks the first scheduled direct connection between the two capitals on Condor’s network.Condor’s codeshare partnership with Etihad Airways strengthens connectivity between Germany and Abu Dhabi by providing passengers travelling from Berlin the ability to connect to destinations across Etihad’s network, while travellers from Abu Dhabi can access Condor’s network through Berlin and beyond.The route supports the continued growth of Abu Dhabi’s tourism sector, offering visitors from Germany greater access to the emirate’s cultural and leisure attractions. It also strengthens the movement of people and supports closer commercial links between Abu Dhabi and Berlin.Carsten Nørland, Chief Commercial Officer of Abu Dhabi Airports, said the launch of Condor’s daily, year-round Berlin service strengthens direct connectivity between two dynamic, outward-looking capitals. "Through our partnership with Condor and Etihad Airways, Zayed International Airport (AUH) is connecting Abu Dhabi with Berlin and beyond, supporting greater opportunities for tourism, business and trade while reinforcing Abu Dhabi’s position as a leading global destination," he added. Haitham Ali Khamis, Acting Director of Tourism Products Development, Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi, stated, “The launch of Condor’s direct service from Berlin is an important step in expanding Abu Dhabi’s reach within the German market. Germany has consistently been a valuable source of visitors, and improved accessibility will help introduce even more travellers to the unique experiences on offer across the emirate.”Dr. Pierre Dominique Prümm, Chief Commercial Officer at Condor Airlines, said, “Together with our codeshare partner Etihad Airways, we are offering our guests not only an attractive direct service to Abu Dhabi, but also seamless connections to numerous destinations across Asia, Australia and Africa. This close cooperation brings together the strengths of both networks and gives our guests even more travel options for both leisure and business.”Lena Havia, Vice President Alliances & Joint Ventures at Etihad Airways, stated, “By bringing together our complementary networks, we are providing guests in Berlin with daily, year-round access to Abu Dhabi, as well as seamless onward connections across Etihad’s network. This is a valuable addition to what we offer in Germany, and a partnership we look forward to growing.”The route adds to Etihad's expanding presence in Germany, which already includes 35 flights a week and a Frankfurt–Abu Dhabi link, with further weekly services planned as the partnership develops.

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: С 16 октября 2026 года аэропорт Зайед в Абу-Даби начал выполнять ежедневные рейсы в Берлин на самолёте Airbus A320neo.
Это первый прямой регулярный рейс между столицами ОАЭ и Германии на маршруте Condor.
Партнёрство Condor с Etihad Airways расширяет возможности пересадки для пассажиров из Берлина и Абу-Даби, обеспечивая доступ к сети направлений обеих авиакомпаний.
Новый маршрут поддерживает развитие туризма и деловых связей между двумя городами.
